picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant to acquire a new supercomputing system is one of the largest single AI-infrastructure investments of the year, dramatically expanding national capacity for AI-driven scientific research.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network, establishing the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, pairs major philanthropic funding with a high-profile academic-national lab partnership to accelerate scientific computing.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment backing 20 Turing AI Fellows represents a substantial national commitment to building UK AI research capacity across disciplines from physics to humanities.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and the AI4Coral partnership with KAUST exemplify how AI and robotics are being deployed internationally to address environmental monitoring challenges at scale.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's multi-laboratory FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations shows AI beginning to accelerate fundamental particle physics research under DOE's Genesis Mission.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial spinout Cogitat for its brain-signal foundation model is a concrete commercial validation of university AI research translating into real-world neurotech products.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College and CNRS's new joint International Research Laboratory formalizes a cross-border, AI-driven approach to metabolic disease research, linking two major research institutions.
picks.title: Metabolism, AI and global health: Imperial and France's CNRS celebrate launch of joint laboratory

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led finding that a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to governments has direct implications for export controls, national security policy, and AI governance worldwide.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloguing 95 distinct AI catastrophic-risk scenarios is a significant contribution to the policy debate on AI safety and governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA's finding that AI materials-prediction models need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and speed of AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials
